n: STEM in the Gym Makey Makey and Scratch Challenge
t: A two-week challenge to design an active PE game with Makey Makey and Scratch.
steps: Find the STEM in the Gym challenge guide from Round Hill PE and read it in full.
Gather one Makey Makey Classic for each group.
Collect foil, paper, conductive tape, and PE equipment.
Check the school's rules for Scratch accounts for students.
Create Scratch accounts for the groups.
Test one foil switch with Scratch before the first class.
